system.description:
Tether Clamp: Make an Interface Roll
against a target within Far range. Ona
success, they’re temporarily Restrained
and must mark a Stress. If you target a
flying creature, this protocol grounds
and temporarily Restrains them.
Firebomb: Make an Interface Roll
against a target within Very Far range.
On a success, launch an explosive
payload, plasma charge, volatile shell,
or drone-delivered bomb toward them
that explodes on impact. The target
and all creatures within Very Close
range of them must make a Reaction
Roll (13). Targets who fail take d20+5
techno damage using your Proficiency.
Targets who succeed take half damage.
